description: What to tag a post with, on any network that can be searched. TikTok is read from the Creative Center trend board: post counts, view counts, and whether each tag is rising, cooling or steady. The other eight — instagram, youtube, douyin, xiaohongshu, twitter, bilibili, reddit, weibo — have no trend board upstream, so the tags are counted across a live sweep of the niche you name, which needs `niche` set and returns no rising/cooling signal because there is no earlier sample to compare against. The result says which of the two it is in `source`; do not present a counted sample as a trend board. One network cannot be swept at all: linkedin. Filter by country and time window on TikTok. Consumes 2 nooticr credits either way. Use to find what to tag, or to spot a wave early.

days.description: Window in days: 7, 30 or 120 (default 7). TikTok only.

industryId.description: Optional TikTok industry id to filter by.

niche.description: Topic to sweep, required for every platform but tiktok — the tags are counted from the posts a search for this returns, so without it there is nothing to count.

platform.description: Network to tag for. Defaults to tiktok, the only one with a real trend board. Anything else counts tags across a sweep and needs `niche`. linkedin cannot be swept.

name: discover_hashtags

available.description: false when the network cannot be swept at all.

example.description: Derived route only — a post that used it.

medianViews.description: Derived route only — views of the median post carrying it.

trend.description: rising, cooling or steady. Trend board only; a sample has none.

cached.description: true when the answer was served from the server's cache, at no cost.

charged.description: false when the call was refused before anything was debited.

niche.description: Derived route only — the sweep the tags were counted from.

note.description: Derived route only — the sample size and what it does not establish.

sweptPosts.description: Derived route only — how many posts were counted.

title: Discover Hashtags
